lookup_validation: N/A — revenue_division does not consume any of the 61 lookup tables

rollback_plan: Initial batch — rollback = truncate revenue_division table and re-import from the prior CSV version if a critical error is found post-import.
post_import_actions_required: Resolve the Suryapet count correction against a primary source
Obtain the AP gazette notification and re-run Stages 3-8 for Andhra Pradesh
